name: urlscan.io
summary: Search and read existing urlscan.io website scans (requests, IPs, domains, certificates, verdicts), hostname history, and on Pro, malicious-observable lookups and similar pages.

api_key.description: A urlscan.io API key (created in your urlscan.io user account), sent in the api-key header. Without one, quotas are minimal.

notes: Quotas are per action (search, result...) and per minute, hour and day, with fixed windows resetting on the minute, hour and midnight UTC; only HTTP 200s count. X-Rate-Limit-* headers report the window closest to running out; over it is a 429.
Submitting a scan is left out on purpose: a scan publishes the URL's page to urlscan.io (public by default). So are visibility changes, saved searches, subscriptions, incidents and live scans.
Queries use Elasticsearch query-string syntax with case-sensitive field names (page.domain:example.com); escape reserved characters and narrow with a date filter such as date:>now-7d.

endpoints.name: Search existing scans
endpoints.summary: Historical scans (and, on Pro, hostnames, certificates, incidents and notifications) matching an Elasticsearch query-string query.

q.description: Elasticsearch query string over scan fields.

size.description: Results to return, up to 10,000 (plan limits apply).

search_after.description: The sort value of the last (oldest) result from the previous call, comma-separated, to get the next page.

datasource.description: Data source: scans (default) or, on urlscan Pro, hostnames, incidents, notifications, certificates.

collapse.description: Field to collapse results on, within the current page only.

notes: Paging: pass the last result's sort as search_after and stop when fewer than size results come back; has_more is only meaningful past 10,000 and total is capped at 10,000.
Finds public scans by anyone plus your own unlisted and private ones. Free and unauthenticated searches may be limited to recent history (search_date_limit_days in the answer).

endpoints.name: Get a scan result
endpoints.summary: The full stored result of an existing scan: the page, its requests, contacted IPs and domains, and verdicts.

scanId.description: Scan UUID, as found in search results.

endpoints.name: Get a hostname's history
endpoints.summary: Historical observations for a hostname from the Hostnames data source.

pageState.description: pageState from the previous answer, for more results.

endpoints.name: Look up an observable in malicious scans
endpoints.summary: How often an IP, hostname, domain or URL appeared in malicious scan results, with first and last seen times (urlscan Pro).

type.description: ip, hostname (exact host), domain (apex, covers subdomains) or url.

value.description: The observable; a url must be URL-encoded.

endpoints.name: Find structurally similar scans
endpoints.summary: Scans whose page structure resembles a given scan's (urlscan Pro).

search_after.description: For older results, as in search.

endpoints.name: Get API quotas
endpoints.summary: Available and used quotas per action and window.
